assignedTasks.title: Main Application Shell & Responsive Grid
assignedTasks.description:
Construct the outer application shell. Requirements:
1. Mobile: Flex column with header, scrollable body, bottom nav.
2. Desktop: CSS Grid with fixed 240px Sidebar, scrollable main content area, right pane for context.
3. Apply Dark Mode palette variables from design system.
4. Route placeholder components into the shell.

assignedTasks.title: Bottom Navigation Bar (Mobile)
assignedTasks.description:
Implement the persistent bottom navigation bar for mobile views. Requirements:
1. 5 distinct icons: Main (Home), Explore (Clipboard), Threads (Chat), Notifications (Bell), Profile (User).
2. Active state styling (Purple highlight/tint).
3. Fixed position at bottom, z-index above content.
4. React Router integration for tab switching.

assignedTasks.title: Desktop Sidebar Menu
assignedTasks.description:
Build the persistent left sidebar for PC layouts. Requirements:
1. 240px width, sticky on scroll.
2. Header branding ('Let\'s Talk').
3. Links matched to bottom nav (Home, Explore, Threads, Charts, Settings).
4. Active route styling.

assignedTasks.title: Loading & Splash Screen
assignedTasks.description:
Create the initial splash loading screen. Requirements:
1. Centered logo with 'Speak Your Mind' tagline.
2. Pulsing animation on the central logo icon.
3. 5-dot loading row sequence.
4. Auto-fade transition to App Shell.
